title: Braised Chicken in Brazilian Gratin
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring tender chicken in a creamy Brazilian gratin sauce. This recipe is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Season the chicken with Chinese five-spice powder, brown sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon of melted butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of melted butter to the skillet.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Brazilian gratin to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushrooms.
Pour the soy sauce into the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mushroom and gratin mixture to the baking dish with the chicken.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.
